name: Braintrust Loop
desc: Assistant inside Braintrust that explains failures and drafts fixes.
desc_zh: Braintrust 内置的助手，解释失败原因并起草修复。
solves: A failing eval gives you a trace and no explanation; Loop reads the production data and says what went wrong.
solves_zh: 一条失败的评测只给一条 trace，不给解释；Loop 会读生产数据，说出问题在哪。
best_for: An eval score drops overnight and you need the cause before the standup.
best_for_zh: 评测分数一夜之间掉了，要在站会前弄清原因。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — braintrust.dev/blog）。 Named in-product capability with its own docs section. Predates the window and is absent from the ledger, so recorded under brief rule (b). 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Loop」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.braintrust.dev/blog/loop
